description: This Java interface defines configuration settings for the public health endpoint of the Ditto Gateway service, including a method to retrieve cache timeout duration and an enum for known config values.

classes.name: PublicHealthConfig
classes.description: An interface providing configuration for the public health endpoint, including cache timeout duration and an enum for known config values.

classes.name: PublicHealthConfig.PublicHealthConfigValue
classes.description: An enumeration of known configuration path expressions with default values for PublicHealthConfig, implementing KnownConfigValue.

methods.name: getCacheTimeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout duration for the cache of external health check information.
